description: Across Greater Manchester, most patients booking a routine GP appointment are seen within two weeks. Same-day urgent slots are usually available; walk-in services are available at most community pharmacies for free blood-pressure checks.
disclaimer: This is an area-level signal, not a personal prediction. Your own wait will depend on your GP practice, your reason for booking, and the time of year.
